status: UNVALIDATED ANALYST SCENARIOS; supporting conventional digital service; no flagship admitted

offer.unit: one accepted source-bound nominal CAD conformance/test artifact with explicitly supplied variants
offer.scope: One public or customer-authorized STEP solid within a frozen analytic-feature envelope; explicit nominal feature program, regenerated nominal STEP and explicitly supplied parameter variants, with frozen digital equivalence tests and one correction cycle. Feature dependencies are not recovered automatically. No general parametric-intent recovery, tolerance inference, released G-code, physical fabrication, physical fitness, process qualification or safe general deployment is offered.
offer.acceptance: Frozen nominal solid-equivalence and explicit-variant checks, source/dependency disclosure, and a buyer-defined recipient-run test on the specified environment. Current public tutorial examples are not customer acceptance. Lost parameter dependencies remain visible.
offer.terms: Proposed only. 50% refundable deposit remains restricted until final digital acceptance; the balance is invoiced at acceptance, due in 30 days. One correction cycle included. Failure means no fee earned, full deposit refund within five days, provider retains its costs and processor fee. Buyer may reject scope before deposit. Accepted digital support is costed and reserved.
offer.permissions: Only public licensed source or buyer-authorized files, explicit derivative/reuse permission; customer-specific data are not pooled without permission; generic source/template reuse is equally available to the conventional shared provider.
offer.outside_options: For the three actual public CadQuery educational examples, free native parameterized source is the strongest available alternative and already generates the intended solid. Doing nothing is also available. No source-access gap, engineering-hour saving or buyer value is inferred from reconstructing these examples.
offer.commercial_admission: HOLD: no buyer-defined unmet need, commissioned acceptance, observed price response or production qualification. All scenarios below are conditional calculations, not authority to offer or deliver a general service.

labor_reference.source: BLS mechanical engineers, May 2025 median USD104110/year, USD50.05/hour
labor_reference.note: Wage anchor, not a customer quote or vendor price. Loaded rate, task hours and all production/resource budgets are assumptions, not measured agent savings.

common_state_note: One hidden state persists across the entire three-prospect cohort. A common qualification gap makes every booked attempt fail; a procurement contraction depresses all buyers' procurement probability. These distributions are illustrative, not calibrated probabilities.
arrangement_note: All arrangements get the same geometry method, asset, inputs, quality and probabilities. Separate preparation repeats the additional commercial setup per booked order; the two shared arrangements perform it once. Proposed and conventional shared must be identical; no AI-exclusive saving is assumed.

financing.funding_kind: modeled owner equity; no credit facility or new expenditure authorized
financing.note: Capital is not revenue. Conditional credit-cost sensitivity is reported separately, not presumed available. Restricted deposits and support reserves cannot finance another order.

retention.note: Identical ordinary library already holds reusable asset. No incremental retained or Gym-trained benefit measured. Additional retention rejected unless future fresh work demonstrates more than its incremental cost.

expansion.population_metric: 2022 U.S. employer establishments, NAICS 332710 Machine shops
expansion.note: A scale threshold only. Establishment counts do not establish eligible buyers, demand, adoption, customer value or obtainable revenue. No terminal venture value enters policy expected values.

scenario_value_note: The zero-value public-source control tests the free native-source outside option. The adverse/central/favorable values and hours refer only to hypothetical future commissioned conformance/test work. They do not value the public tutorial examples and have no buyer calibration.
cost_completeness_note: Loaded labor is assumed to cover salary, benefits and ordinary facilities/management. Compute/storage, permissions administration, acquisition, correction, support, contracts/qualification and failed refunds are explicitly budgeted. Insurance/license obligations beyond the stated digital scope are unknown and are a commercial-admission blocker; scenarios are complete only under their stated finite obligation assumptions.
